periods.time: Immediately after the citizens' vigil explanation

name.zh: 史黛菈安抚露娜艾丝并点燃国葬篝火
name.en: Stella Reassures Lunaeyes and Lights the Funeral Pyre

periods.summary: Lunaeyes argues that citizens staying is irrational because Or-Gaule's group will destroy them if Vermillion loses. Stella cups her sister's face and insists they will not lose. She tells Lunaeyes not to sacrifice what she treasures to Or-Gaule, draws out Lunaeyes's suppressed wish to save John, and promises to protect Vermillion, Quedland, John, and Lunaeyes herself. Stella then manifests her evolved Laevateinn and lights the national funeral pyre, asking everyone to believe in her because Crimson Princess is invincible when they do.
periods.cause: Lunaeyes's rational self-sacrifice and hidden bargain with Or-Gaule clash with the citizens' refusal to evacuate and Stella's new life-affirming resolve.
periods.process: Stella names the likely hidden price, urges Lunaeyes not to give up her precious things, accepts the wish to save John, and declares her promise before the citizens and fallen soldiers' pyre.
periods.outcome: Lunaeyes chooses to trust Stella and wait with the people; Stella stands as the true sword and future symbol of Vermillion heading into the war.
periods.significance: Completes Stella's transformation from self-destructive protector to leader who accepts public faith and vows total victory without sacrificing loved ones.
